description: App-only: confirm a completed R2 upload (single PUT or multipart) for an Inbox interview. Audio/video is enqueued for transcription (STT + diarization). Text (.txt/.md) and PDF are stored and marked ready immediately — no transcription.

language.description: STT language for audio/video (e.g. en, ru, nl). Not used for text/PDF (no transcription).

multipart_parts.description: Completed parts (part_number + etag) when using multipart.

multipart_upload_id.description: Multipart upload id — complete assembly before confirm.

title.description: Optional title to apply before confirm.
